name: Domik v derevne - u reki
source:
Greetings, stranger. Which brings you to our cozy tavern full of mischievous fun. Sit closer to the fireplace, let in one hand you hold a fragrant foamy beer, complemented to the brim, and in the other you wash the lush boobs of a juicy girl who would twirl her ass on her knee, so that when bringing beer to your mouth, it flows down your mustache yes did not get into the mouth. And everywhere you hear fascinating stories, one after another they are replaced, just like the beer in the mug was refreshed and in every sip, you are ready to absorb more and more new adventures. So delight your passionate curiosity to see our adventure story, where vices are glorified in a dance of recklessness and passion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你好，陌生人。是什么风，把你吹进了我们这间充满淘气乐趣的温馨酒馆？靠近壁炉坐下吧，一手握着盛满芳香泡沫啤酒的杯子，另一手揉弄丰腴姑娘饱满的乳房。她在你膝上扭动屁股，让你举杯喝酒时，酒液只顺着胡须流下，却进不了嘴。四周不断响起引人入胜的故事，一个接着一个，正如杯中啤酒一次次续满，每喝一口，你都准备好吞下更多新的冒险。那就让热烈的好奇心得到满足，来看看我们的冒险故事，在鲁莽与激情的舞步中，尽情歌颂种种恶习。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467810/]Steam[/url]]
